definitions.gloss: whipped to soft peaks; whipped about 70 percent
definitions.explanation: A stage of whipping cream where it thickens and forms soft peaks that fold over, but is not yet stiff. Literally "seven-tenths whipped." Used when a soft, pourable texture is wanted.

examples.japanese: ⟦{生|なま}クリーム→生クリーム：15884_namakuriimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{七分立|しちぶだ}て⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Whip the cream to soft peaks.

examples.japanese: {七分立|しちぶだ}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦クリーム→クリーム：00253_kuriimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦そっと→そっと：03321_sotto⟧⟦{混|ま}ぜる→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧。
examples.english: Gently fold in the soft-whipped cream.

examples.japanese: ムース⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、とろりとした{七分立|しちぶだ}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦クリーム→クリーム：00253_kuriimu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ちょうどいい→ちょうどいい：21521_choudoii⟧。
examples.english: For mousse, cream whipped to soft, flowing peaks is just right.

notes:
A baking term literally meaning "seven-tenths whipped," formed from {七分|しちぶ} (seven parts) + {立|だ}て (whipping, from ⟦{泡立|あわだ}てる→泡立てる：06419_awadateru⟧). Describes cream at a soft-peak stage that still flows slowly and folds over on the whisk.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {七分立|しちぶだ}て⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to whip to soft peaks
- {七分立|しちぶだ}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦クリーム→クリーム：00253_kuriimu⟧: soft-whipped cream

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{八分立|はちぶだ}て→八分立て：29705_hachibudate⟧: whipped to firm peaks — one stage stiffer, holds its shape
- ⟦{泡立|あわだ}てる→泡立てる：06419_awadateru⟧: to whip, to beat — the underlying verb
